simple.summary: שׁוּחָמִי (Shûwchâmîy) means a Shuchamite (collectively) First listed occurrence: Num 26 42.

definitions.full: H7749. Shuchami שׁוּחָמִי adjective, of a people of foregoing; with article ׳הַשּׁ as collective noun Num 26:42 . [ יְשׁוֺחָיָה ] proper name, masculine see below שׁחח .
